subject.title: Inject sibling agent list into session system prompt

question: Should OpenClaw expose sibling-agent roster metadata to model-visible session context, and if so should it be automatic prompt text or an allowlist-aware discovery tool result?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing identity/theme/description and communication-permission metadata changes what an agent can see about other configured agents, which requires maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Prefer Gated Tool Discovery
options.body: Expose only authorized, bounded sibling metadata through `agents_list` or a similar discovery tool and avoid automatic prompt injection by default.

options.title: Inject Minimal Prompt Roster
options.body: Add a compact prompt section for allowed siblings if maintainers accept the token, cache, and metadata-exposure cost.

options.title: Reject Core Roster Exposure
options.body: Keep current id-only discovery plus explicit docs/config and close or supersede the broader roster request as outside the core context contract.

recommendation.title: Prefer Gated Tool Discovery
recommendation.body: Expose only authorized, bounded sibling metadata through `agents_list` or a similar discovery tool and avoid automatic prompt injection by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced `agents_list` and has the strongest feature-history signal for the model-visible multi-agent discovery boundary.
